title: Tool contract (bmo-tool)
what: The crate every tool and the host are written to: the tool.toml manifest, the call protocol on standard input and the call-back socket, the session record, answers and their ceiling. Lives in sdk/contract.

title: Python tool kit
what: The helper a Python tool reads its call and answers it with, and asks another entry through the call-back socket, on protocol 1. Lives in sdk/py-kit.

title: TypeScript tool kit
what: The helper a TypeScript tool reads its call and answers it with, and asks another entry through the call-back socket, on protocol 1. Lives in sdk/ts-kit.
